text:
Maria (Partnerships): quick thread — we need to rebalance Q2 MDF after the cloud marketplace push and a couple of HW co-sell asks. can we lock allocations before next Wed's QBR?
Dan (Finance): what ballpark numbers are we talking? do we have current utilization by partner tier?
Liam (Sales Ops): sharing quick snapshot — Tier A (strategic SI + HW): 65% pipeline coverage, Tier B (marketplace listed partners): 22%, Tier C: 13%. conversion rates dropping in Tier B after the listing change.
Sofia (GTM): recommendation — shift 20% of Tier C MDF to top 3 SIs and 1 HW program (they've committed co-marketing). that should fuel joint announcement + enable a demo stack for marketplace leads.
Ava (Revenue Ops): agree but need scorecard thresholds updated before we reassign. specifically: influence >= $250k pipeline last 90d OR 3 joint customers closed = Tier A eligibility. else holdback.
Maria (Partnerships): noted. can we iterate on thresholds live? Dan, can finance approve a conditional reallocation pending scorecard signoff?
Dan (Finance): we can approve a provisional reallocation up to $150k today, contingent on final scorecards by EOD Fri. anything >$150k needs director OK.
mdf-bot: new MDF request template v2 deployed — use `/mdf request` to file. auto-tags requests with partner tier and last-90d-influence. :robot_face:
Liam (Sales Ops): here's a quick allocation table for the proposal:
```
line: target_partner_group | current_mdf | proposed_mdf_change
1: Top 3 SIs           | $180,000    | +$90,000
2: Strategic HW partner | $50,000     | +$60,000
3: Tier B marketplace   | $120,000    | -$80,000
4: Tier C               | $60,000     | -$70,000
```
Sofia (GTM): if we reroute as above, we should earmark $40k for a joint announcement bundle (press + webinar + co-demos). need signoff from comms but it's high ROI.
Ava (Revenue Ops): I'll update the partner scorecard spreadsheet and push a link to the QBR deck. also adding a gating column: `mdf_release` = `manual` vs `auto` so Finance can see which need extra review.
Maria (Partnerships): action items: (1) Ava — publish updated scorecard by Fri EOD. (2) Liam — file MDF requests with `/mdf request` using mdf-bot template and tag approvals. (3) Dan — provisional $150k approval in place, escalate anything >$150k. (4) Sofia — draft joint announcement plan and estimated comms budget.
Dan (Finance): ack. will shepherd director approval if we hit the >$150k threshold.
Sofia (GTM): I'll add comms tasks to the QBR slide and ping comms for a 30-min sync tomorrow.
Maria (Partnerships): perfect — I'll add this to the QBR agenda under "Partner ops: MDF rebalancing + joint announcements" and circle back once scorecards are in. thanks team :thumbsup:
Liam (Sales Ops): one more — hardware partner requested a boxed demo on-prem. if we approve, add $25k to the HW line. tagging for decision.
Dan (Finance): noted. treat as conditional until we see a PO or co-funding.
Ava (Revenue Ops): will add `req_docs` column to the spreadsheet for POs/agreements.
Maria (Partnerships): closing thread — QBR prep slot confirmed Wed 10:30 PT. hoping to present final allocation then.
Sofia (GTM): see you there 👍
